name: bitchat
description: bitchat BLE mesh peer — fingerprints mainnet/testnet from the advertised 128-bit service UUID; central quick action reads signed announce identity after GATT subscribe.
author: BLESPlo.it
notes: Source: permissionlesstech/bitchat BLEService.buildAdvertisementData() advertises only CBAdvertisementDataServiceUUIDsKey. Mainnet F47B5E2D-4A9E-4C5A-9B3F-8E1D2C3A4B5C (release), testnet …4B5A (DEBUG). GATT characteristic A1B2C3D4-E5F6-4A5B-8C9D-0E1F2A3B4C5D (notify/write/writeWithoutResponse/read) carries BinaryProtocol packets; MessageType.announce (0x01) TLVs hold nickname, Noise/Ed25519 keys, neighbors, capabilities. Central: subscribe then wait for announce (~0.4s; rate-limited under reconnect churn). Signature verification not performed.
